original.target_description: Experiment 1: undergraduate participants rated John on two aggressiveness items, averaged into an aggressiveness score; 3 (global/local/control processing) × 2 (aggression/no-aggression semantic priming) between-participants ANOVA interaction.

notes:
Replication ES and p are paired from Table 4. Table 3 supplies protocol N; some Table 3 point estimates/intervals differ slightly from Table 4. Narrative success is not inferred from p. Original full text unavailable after bounded primary/open-access acquisition.
Source follow-up: Original-only fresh blind validation. Supplied published article title and DOI match the original reference. The target is the omnibus processing × semantic priming interaction on aggressiveness, explicitly identified as the predicted interaction at the supplied page locator. F is retained as requested, without metric conversion. Analytic n is null because the final count is not explicitly printed; the stated cohort and six nonparticipants are recorded separately rather than substituting the generic cohort count or calculating n from degrees of freedom. Quote separator | marks two separately quoted passages. Source version: published article supplied by licensed EBSCO PsycInfo service. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
